haiku-low.q1: Held 10 minutes. If not claimed in time, the reservation becomes EXPIRED and stock goes back on sale, whatever the payment state.
haiku-low.q2: Before the charge. Reservation is all-or-nothing: if any line is short, nothing is reserved, no payment is requested, and the order is REJECTED_OUT_OF_STOCK.
haiku-low.q3: The order id is the idempotency key. A retried POST /charges returns the existing charge, so the customer is not charged again.
haiku-low.q4: The claim returns 409, so Order sets CANCELLED_OUT_OF_STOCK. Payment refunds the full amount, and Order emails the customer a cancellation.
haiku-low.q5: Cart deletes its lines when it receives OrderConfirmed. On failed checkout the cart is unchanged, since Place order writes nothing to Cart.
haiku-low.q6: Order runs the checkout and moves it between steps. Progress is recorded in the orders table and order_status_history.
haiku-low.q7: The provider sends a webhook to Payment, which records it and publishes PaymentSucceeded or PaymentDeclined through its outbox for Order to act on.
haiku-low.q8: Each webhook event id is stored uniquely in webhook_events. A repeat returns 200 and changes nothing. A charge outcome is also set only once.
haiku-low.q9: Payment publishes PaymentDeclined. Order sets PAYMENT_DECLINED and posts a release to Inventory, which frees the stock if still HELD, or does nothing if EXPIRED.
haiku-low.q10: The claim decides. If the reservation is still HELD and not expired, the order is confirmed. If the hold has lapsed, the order is cancelled and refunded, even when stock is free.
haiku-low.q11: Payment retries with backoff using the same key, storing attempts and last error. After N attempts ops is alerted. The pending refund stays in the refunds table.
haiku-low.q12: Order publishes OrderConfirmed once the claim succeeds and the order is confirmed. Cart then deletes the cart lines.

sonnet.q1: Held for 10 minutes. If not claimed, the expiry job marks the reservation EXPIRED and the held stock goes back to free stock (back on sale); Order is not changed.
sonnet.q2: Stock is reserved before the charge. If any line is short, nothing is reserved (all-or-none transaction), Inventory replies 409 with short SKUs, no payment is requested, and the order becomes REJECTED_OUT_OF_STOCK.
sonnet.q3: The charge uses the order id as idempotency key; a retried POST /charges with the same key returns the existing charge (and the provider call uses the same key).
sonnet.q4: Claim returns 409, Order sets CANCELLED_OUT_OF_STOCK and publishes PaymentRefundRequired; Payment refunds the full amount via the provider; Order emails the customer about the cancellation, and again once the refund is confirmed.
sonnet.q5: The cart is emptied (cart lines deleted) only when Cart receives OrderConfirmed. On failure (short stock, declined payment) the cart is unchanged. Cart rows are not changed on Place order.
sonnet.q6: Order drives the checkout step by step (calling Inventory and Payment, reacting to payment events). The record is the orders status field plus order_status_history in Order's database.
sonnet.q7: The provider sends a charge webhook to Payment; Payment records it, sets the charge outcome, and publishes PaymentSucceeded or PaymentDeclined (via its outbox and the broker), which Order consumes to finish the order.
sonnet.q8: Payment stores each provider event id as unique in webhook_events; a repeat event id gets a 200 reply with no change and nothing published. Also the charge outcome is set only once (first wins), and downstream receivers ignore repeats.
sonnet.q9: Payment publishes PaymentDeclined; Order sets PAYMENT_DECLINED and POSTs release to Inventory, which releases the reservation if still HELD (no-op if already EXPIRED).
sonnet.q10: It does not decide on free stock: if the claim finds the hold lapsed (409), it always refunds in full and cancels as out of stock, even if the stock is still free. Fulfilment only happens if the reservation is still HELD and not expired.
sonnet.q11: Payment stores attempts and last error on the refunds row, retries with backoff using the same key, and after N attempts alerts ops; the row is kept. Pending refund is tracked in Payment's refunds table. A failed refund webhook also keeps it PENDING and retries.
sonnet.q12: The OrderConfirmed event published by Order causes the Cart service to delete the cart lines.
